summary: The community.network collection is unmaintained and deprecated. Anyone interested should copy the parts they need into their own repository and announce it on the forum.
questions: What should I do if I rely on community.network modules?

answer_card.title: community.network is unmaintained
answer_card.answer_md: All of `community.network` is unmaintained and deprecated. To keep using parts of it, copy them into your own repository (see the collection creator path) and mention it in the forum discussion.
